title: Neumann 1992 lumbar ALL substance cross-sectional area and segment geometry

quantity.name: ligament substance area
quantity.definition: ALL substance cross-sectional area (LA); also motion-segment height (MSH) and anterior/posterior disc height

source.authors: Neumann P, Keller TS, Ekstrom L, Perry L, Hansson TH, Spengler DM
source.sample: 6 bone-ALL-bone preparations from 3 male cadavers (21, 29, 43 y); human lumbar ALL (T12-L1 to L4-L5), young donors, normal discs

protocol.summary: Bone-ALL-bone preparations (disc and PLL dissected away, ALL intact); vertebrae pinned with 4 Steinmann pins each; no mechanical preconditioning; distraction to failure at constant crosshead rate 2.5 mm/s (~1.07 %/s overall ligament strain rate); 12 video markers on ALL; tissue irrigated with 0.9% saline. Stress = load / ligament substance area (LA); overall strain from outermost marker pairs (e1-4); moduli = slope of linear region (LZ) of stress-strain.
how_to_simulate: Compare model ALL CSA with LA

extraction.check_notes: Read from Table 1 (OCR matched). doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
